integrity: One analytic theorem with a self-contained proof and a finite executable checking program; calculations do not replace the infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit or definitive publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The primitive period-two classification is local near the listed fixed points and thresholds.
Fixed-point exhaustiveness is established only under KW<2pi; the theorem does not exclude additional nonzero-winding fixed points at larger parameters.
Linear ellipticity does not establish nonlinear stability, KAM islands, or global ergodicity.
The asymptotics hold at fixed W and are not uniform as W tends to infinity.
An unindexed earlier derivation of the same family-specific coefficients remains possible.
title: Synchronized flip resonances and elliptic two-cycles in a multiharmonic kicked rotor
